verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control, such as a setting or environment variable to disable analytics. Claims that Open WebUI is 'built to run entirely offline' and offers an enterprise air-gapped deployment are adjacent network-isolation postures, not an opt-out of telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
